definitions.explanation: Pain in the abdomen or stomach area, which may have various causes such as indigestion, illness, or stress.

examples.japanese: {腹痛|ふくつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I was absent from school because of a bad stomachache.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べすぎて→食べ過ぎる：21686_tabesugiru⟧{腹痛|ふくつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: I got a stomachache from eating too much cold food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{腹痛|ふくつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: I was struck by a sudden stomachache.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧{腹痛|ふくつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: I always get nervous before exams and develop a stomachache.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{腹痛|ふくつう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{下痢|げり}→下痢：05382_geri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{食|しょく}あたり→食あたり：08422_shokuatari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I had severe stomachache and diarrhea that wouldn't stop, so I went to the hospital thinking it might be food poisoning.

notes:
{腹痛|ふくつう} is the Sino-Japanese word used by doctors, on medical forms, and in news and written Japanese. In conversation, people usually say ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {腹痛|ふくつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to develop a stomachache
- {腹痛|ふくつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to complain of abdominal pain
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{腹痛|ふくつう}: severe abdominal pain
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{腹痛|ふくつう}: sudden abdominal pain
